basis: Native-force IMU / rotating ESKF; paired seed-0 runs, 30 seed trials, and 15 ascent replays

robustness.conventions: Means over seeds; NEES bands are pointwise ensemble bands, not independent tests over correlated time samples. Constant injected biases; all channels retain modeled noise and 1 degree alignment uncertainty.

conventions.vector_errors: Euclidean vector norm; sample RMSE and maximum on each nav grid
conventions.attitude: Shortest quaternion rotation angle, radians in JSON; degrees in tables
conventions.contact: Interpolated radial ground contact; nav grid stops before terminal contact
conventions.replay: One fixed calibrated identity trajectory; identical samples and initial posterior; no estimator feeds back into the replay plant
conventions.imu_only: GNSS/radar initialization retained, all subsequent aiding disabled
conventions.outage: Same samples, GNSS updates disabled at t=4 through 8 s; radar retained
conventions.scope: Ten seeds per landing condition; five seeds per 150-second ascent condition; pointwise NEES and NIS diagnostics, not operational qualification
